items.quote: If you also see the pack, which my colleagues have put out, we have grown our business banking, which is mainly representative of our MSME, we've grown at about 20% year -on-year, and that will continue to also be in that range of 18% to 20%, 21%, depending upon, obviously, some of the developments in the economy.
items.why: By September the MSME and mid-market book was growing 23.5% a year, above the range.
items.actual_quote: September'26 EOP loan growth has grown 23.5 % year -on-year compared to 17% to 18% year-on-year growth levels seen in the last few quarters.
